notes.title: Adult Only Update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41256726/78ca8d7c5f0fc53e6c63cb5e6407770de5d20ed1.png
Hey guys!

The reason the game was SFW with 18+ DLC - is that i wanted to make it visible for the players who didn't have "Show me adult stuff" checkbox selected in Steam settings, and make more people happy!
 
But as long as we can see - it has an opposite effect.

It was restricted for me to say anything about an Adult Only DLC.
And most of guys just saw the lazy blackjack game with 3 pictures in it and no fun at all.
That was too sad for me to see and have no way to tell them how to make this game more fun!

Today i'm setting the Hentai Spirit of the game Free!
Now it's ADULT ONLY by default and you don't have to find and install the 18+ DLC anymore!

ALSO:
[olist]
 Survival mode - you can try your skills for real!
 Proper rules for the dealer (17 plus thing)
 UI design this game desurves!
 More girls for you to play is on their way to the game.

[/olist]

Stay healthy and have fun!
